architecture: Use semantic HTML and a version-pinned Bootstrap 5.3.8 dependency.
Keep domain logic and protected data outside the presentation layer.
Separate app-specific styles and reusable components from vendor files.
Use server validation for real account, upload, price, inventory, or payment operations.
